metadata.title: Milky Way potentials in CDM and MOND. Is the Large Magellanic Cloud on a bound orbit?

notes: No eligible individual stars are identified. The paper's unbound/escaping analysis concerns the LMC and SMC, which are satellite galaxies rather than stars (T:p8-b6, I:p8-b0, I:p9-b2). Hypervelocity stars are mentioned only as an unidentified population, without individual names or identifiers (T:p9-b8).
